the_violet_spire.changed: Structure shots now stand among the islands and spires instead of on top of them. The forced large tower and the fortified temple are gone: both stood in the void. The castle ruin and the wizard tower stay. The wisteria/lavender share and cliff targets still miss; the region targets are now measured by place.
the_violet_spire.why: Night-only; amethyst 8.9% of the top blocks, crystal hollows 6.7%. Measured by place, the three bands pass: the largest three hold 79.4% of the land, 7 major regions, specks 0.8%, each island 65.5% one place. Spires reach y 236.
misses: Wisteria and lavender 23.9% of the surface (target 25). A variant at 48 wisteria reaches the target, but the crystal place falls from 6.7% to 2.1%. The owner asked for crystals, so this stays a named exception.
Cliffs 3.6% of slopes (target 15): the spires have flat tops so growth can stand on them (the owner's note). Thinner spires measured 5.9%. Named exception.
the_violet_spire.exception: The description's cliff share and the wisteria share both trade against the owner's crystals and flat spire tops.

the_sunken_temple.changed: Structure shots taken from under the islands. The sinking temple stands on an island edge over the water, and a castle ruin stands on a high island. The forced ocean temple and the monument have no start that passes generation's terrain checks on this seed.
misses: Land regions: the largest three 16.9% (target 60), 18 major (8), specks 15.1% (5). The owner's raised water drowns the skyland bases, so the land is island tops. Measured by place it is still scattered (19.7%, 17 major). Named exception.
Hanging gardens 10.5% (target 10 or less).
Ocean temple, monument and underwater dungeon: no start passes generation's checks on this seed.
The conduit ruins are under water, and every frame there is occluded.
the_sunken_temple.exception: The land metrics assume a few large regions; the raised water leaves many island tops. Closing it needs larger skyland islands or fewer of them.

the_abyssal_shrine.changed: The lake is wider: ring radius 440, falloff 110, a shelf of 32. Water covers 29.1% of the map (16.5% before). The shelf meets the ring all round (render). The forced monument stands on the lake floor and is shot there.
the_abyssal_shrine.why: Water 29.1%, deep oceans 31.5%, void 29.5%. All five biomes are present; 9 of 10 description and 6 of 6 placeness targets pass.
misses: Plateaus 4.3% of landforms (target 15). The ring land is rolling highland, and the classifier reads it as hills. Named exception.
The vault and shrine stand-ins (underwater dungeon, warden monument, castle ruin) have no start that passes generation's checks.

the_molten_flats.changed: Five structures shot on the flats. The mega fortress and the piglin outstation stand in open lava.
misses: Lava 16.8% (target 20-45): the owner asked for magma in boxed pockets with lava only at the centres of the larger pools. The owner's note supersedes the description's share; named exception.

Trees 2.7 a hectare (target 2): every counted stem is stripped crimson stem, the timber of the placed structures. No Nether tree grows them, so the flats have no natural trees. Restated: the miss counts structures, not trees.

the_forged_depths.changed: Structures shot among the crags: a fortress built into them, a ruined keep with a bridge, a forge tower on a crag, the piglin donjon.
misses: Largest land region 39.7% (target 50), specks 6.9% (5): the owner asked for crags, and they break the pinewood region. Named exception.
Pinewood and crimson forest are placed but judged unexpressed without their trees (the owner removed the trees). The survey judges them by trees, not ground.
the_forged_depths.exception: The survey should judge a biome whose trees a definition removed by its ground.

the_wailing_narrows.changed: The six bridges are removed: their decks hang in the air at y 30-34 on thin pillars and cross no crevice. The quartz targets follow the owner's removal of quartz.
misses: Bridges: the description's 'narrow bridged chasms' needs a bridge that spans a crevice wall to wall. That waits on a set piece; none of the pack's bridges can be placed that way.
An ancient city start lies below the floor at y -64 to -10, in rock, with no way to it. It is not in the dimension's list; where it comes from is unresolved.

the_gilded_pit.changed: Eleven structures shot on the ledges and in the pit: bastion, fortress, mega fortress, keep, donjon with cart rails, hamlet, port, tower, forge, walls, sealing halls.
misses: Spawn 48 blocks from the biome edge (target 64): the landing belongs at the lip. Restated.
The dark keep (y 103-161) and the piglin outstation could not be seen from any camera.
The pit is not visible from the landing in the fog.

the_bloodroot_wastes.changed: Structures shot in the crimson caverns: the forge at a lava shore, the wells and the giant fungus in the forest. The piglin camp colony hangs on chains under a rock ceiling.
misses: The piglin camp and the second giant fungus could not be shot: every camera is in rock.

the_end.changed: All twelve outer-island zones are now shot: each frame stands on its own zone's land. Twelve End structures are shot on their islands.
misses: Largest land region 0.3% (target 20): the outer End is many islands, and the owner keeps the central island classic. Named exception.

the_nether.changed: The piglin village want is removed: its start stands on the roof (y 115-158). Bridges are shot on the lava sea, plus the fortress, bastion, mega fortress, fossil and sealing halls.
misses: Bridge 2 shows no deck in its frame; bridge 5 could not be shot.
